name: @jeldon/content-model
description: Domain-agnostic article content model: frontmatter codec (preserves unknown fields), the draft→docReviewed→ready→scheduled→live lifecycle state machine, a Zod article schema derived from content.categories, validateArticle, and publishScheduled. Consolidates the triple-implemented BoH frontmatter parser into one source.

jeldonVendored.note: Built dist copied from the Jeldon monorepo. Swap to the npm version once @jeldon/* is published.
